es: Entender un blog de viajes con formas perfectas y pasivas e identificar qué vivió la autora, qué le hicieron y qué recomienda.

teaching.en: Having travelled alone for a month, I can give you some advice.
teaching.es: Después de viajar sola durante un mes, puedo darte algunos consejos.
teaching.explanationEs: Having + participio al inicio: explica la experiencia que da autoridad.
segments: Having travelled alone for a month,
I can give you some advice.
teaching.audioText: Having travelled alone for a month, I can give you some advice.

teaching.en: My first tip: avoid being charged double by asking the price first.
teaching.es: Mi primer consejo: evita que te cobren el doble preguntando antes el precio.
teaching.explanationEs: Avoid + being + participio: evitar que otros nos hagan algo.
segments: My first tip: avoid being charged
double by asking the price first.
teaching.audioText: My first tip: avoid being charged double by asking the price first.

teaching.en: I was happy to have been given a local map at the hostel.
teaching.es: Me alegré de que me dieran un mapa local en el albergue.
teaching.explanationEs: To have been given: algo que recibí antes.
segments: I was happy to have been given
a local map at the hostel.
teaching.audioText: I was happy to have been given a local map at the hostel.

teaching.en: I recommend visiting the market early, and it is worth going before ten.
teaching.es: Te recomiendo visitar el mercado temprano, y vale la pena ir antes de las diez.
teaching.explanationEs: Recommend y worth van seguidos de -ing.
segments: I recommend visiting the market early, and
it is worth going before ten.
teaching.audioText: I recommend visiting the market early, and it is worth going before ten.

teaching.en: If you are asked to pay before seeing the room, it is probably a scam.
teaching.es: Si te piden pagar antes de ver la habitación, probablemente es una estafa.
teaching.explanationEs: Are asked: a ti te piden; before + -ing: antes de ver.
segments: If you are asked to pay before seeing
the room, it is probably a scam.
teaching.audioText: If you are asked to pay before seeing the room, it is probably a scam.

teaching.en: Having queued for an hour once, I now avoid the queue: I go before eight.
teaching.es: Después de hacer cola una hora una vez, ahora evito la cola: voy antes de las ocho.
teaching.explanationEs: Having queued explica por qué cambió su costumbre.
segments: Having queued for an hour once, I now
avoid the queue: I go before eight.
teaching.audioText: Having queued for an hour once, I now avoid the queue: I go before eight.

prompt.es: Según el texto, ¿qué le hicieron a la autora la primera noche?

choices.text: She was given a local map.
She was charged double by a taxi driver.
She missed the old market.

feedback.es: Al llegar, dice «I remember being charged double by a taxi driver». El mapa lo recibió en el albergue y el mercado lo perdió otro día.

hint.es: Busca being o been + participio: algo que otros hicieron a la autora.

origin.text: Three days in Lisbon, by Mia. Having travelled alone for a month, I learned a few things. I remember being charged double by a taxi driver on my first night, so my first tip is to ask the price before you get in. I was happy to have been given a local map at the hostel: it is worth asking the staff for one. I also regret having missed the old market, so I recommend going early.

prompt.es: Según el texto, ¿qué lamenta la autora?

choices.text: Having travelled alone.
Having asked the price.
Having missed the old market.

feedback.es: Después de regret aparece having missed the old market: eso es lo que lamenta. Viajar sola y preguntar el precio no los lamenta.

hint.es: Busca el verbo regret: va seguido de having + participio.

origin.text: Three days in Lisbon, by Mia. Having travelled alone for a month, I learned a few things. I remember being charged double by a taxi driver on my first night, so my first tip is to ask the price before you get in. I was happy to have been given a local map at the hostel: it is worth asking the staff for one. I also regret having missed the old market, so I recommend going early.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada frase con el tipo de información que aporta.

pairs: Having walked all day, I slept well.
I remember being asked for my ticket.

feedback.es: Having + participio cuenta algo que hizo la autora, being + participio algo que le hicieron y worth/recommend dan un consejo.

hint.es: Pregunta quién hace la acción, y si es un consejo para otros.

pairs: Having walked all day, I slept well.
I remember being asked for my ticket.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige por qué pagó la autora.

choices.text: She paid because she went on a Monday.
She paid because the castle was closed.
She paid because nobody told her about Sundays.

feedback.es: Dice que fue un lunes y por eso pagó diez euros; los domingos es gratis.

origin.audio: I remember being told that the castle is free on Sundays. Having gone on a Monday, I paid ten euros. My advice: check the day before you go.

prompt.es: Según el texto, ¿qué aconseja la autora para evitar las colas?

choices.text: Buying a card at the station.
Going before eight.
Asking the locals.

feedback.es: Después de hacer cola una hora, recomienda ir antes de las ocho. La tarjeta es para evitar que la paren y los locales son para evitar un restaurante lleno.

origin.text: Porto tips. I avoid being stopped on the tram by buying a card at the station. Having queued for an hour once, I now recommend going before eight. One guide admitted having sent me to a crowded restaurant, so ask the locals.

prompt.es: Completa: «Merece la pena hablar con un local antes de elegir un restaurante.»

feedback.es: Después de worth se usa -ing: talking (o speaking).

origin.text: It is worth ___ to a local before you choose a restaurant.

prompt.es: Según el diario, ¿qué aconseja la autora?

choices.text: Always ask a local to pay.
Stay in the same hostel.
Never pay before seeing the room.

feedback.es: La autora cuenta que le pidieron pagar antes de ver la habitación y que era una estafa: su consejo es no pagar antes de verla.

origin.text: Rome diary. I remember being asked to pay before seeing the room, and it was a scam. I regret having paid, so my advice is: never pay first. A local told me about a better hostel, and I was glad to have been told the way.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué le pasó al viajero.

choices.text: He lost a phone and now carries a paper map.
He found a phone in Prague.
He bought a new phone in Prague.

feedback.es: «Having lost my phone» cuenta lo que le pasó, y ahora lleva un mapa de papel.

origin.audio: Having lost my phone in Prague, I now keep a paper map. My tip is to write the hostel's address on paper as well.

prompt.es: Une cada frase del diario con lo que cuenta: vivido, recibido o consejo.

pairs: Having lived here for years, she knows every street.
I remember being sent to the wrong room.
I recommend booking a day before.

feedback.es: Cada frase cumple una función: la experiencia se cuenta con having + participio, lo recibido con being + participio y el consejo con recommend.

pairs: Having lived here for years, she knows every street.
I remember being sent to the wrong room.
I recommend booking a day before.

prompt.es: Completa: «Recomiendo reservar el albergue antes de llegar: se llena.»

origin.text: I recommend ___ the hostel before you arrive, because it fills up fast.

prompt.es: ¿Qué hicieron los viajeros después de perder el último autobús?

choices.text: They took a taxi.
They walked for two hours.
They slept at the station.

feedback.es: El texto dice «Having missed the last bus, we walked for two hours»: primero perdieron el autobús y después caminaron.

origin.text: Travel note: «Having missed the last bus, we walked for two hours. Nobody told us the road was closed. I'm glad to have seen the sky that night.»

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué hace la persona para no pagar de más.

choices.text: The speaker is charged extra at the market.
The speaker never goes to the market.
The speaker pays with small notes.

feedback.es: Evita que le cobren de más pagando con billetes pequeños.

origin.audio: I avoid being charged extra by paying in the market with small notes. It is worth carrying some.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Merece la pena pedir consejo a un local.»

answer.text: It is worth asking a local for advice

feedback.es: It is worth + -ing: asking; for advice completa la idea.
